Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an existing moemoa logo concept sheet. Make a focused logo SYMBOL revision only. CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve the rounded lowercase wordmark "moemoa", m-o-e-m-o-a, in both large mint and small off-white versions, retaining exact rounded contours, stroke weight, spacing, position, overall scale, colors, background and composition as closely as possible. Do not re-typeset or restyle the lettering. No new text. Replace ONLY the left symbol in the main lockup and its two standalone copies at the bottom, with the same new symbol. Retain the pale mint and off-white color variants and flat clean vector-like finish. Keep the same original wide sheet layout and aspect ratio. No 3D, shadows, camera/projector, play triangle, movie clapboard, ornamental scratches, additional slogans or watermarks. The updated symbol should feel soft and rounded like the existing lettering, distinctive at small size, and suggest a personal film archive rather than a video player. SYMBOL DIRECTION: Keep the original three rounded fanned cards and their fan angle, silhouette and approximate proportions. Turn them into three short photographic film frames. The foremost frame has a large clean rectangular negative-space exposure window with softly rounded corners, plus THREE robust small rounded-rectangle sprocket perforations along each of its two vertical edges. The two rear frames have only a few visible matching perforations. Clear substantial mint bridges between holes; NOT a dense tiny dotted border. This should be recognizably the same fan symbol, now unmistakably three film frames.
CRITICAL RENDERING CORRECTION: Output a perfectly SHARP flat vector-style logo sheet on a SOLID OPAQUE PURE BLACK (#000000) background. All mint shapes must be uniformly solid opaque #B1E1CA; white variants uniformly #EDF2F3. NO glow, NO bloom, NO blur, NO neon, NO haze, NO shadow, NO transparency in logo fills. The original lettering is a thick RING/STROKE construction, NOT solid blobs: every counter in m, o, e, m, o, a must be open PURE BLACK negative space, especially the two round o counters. The perforations and rectangular frame windows must be clearly cut-out PURE BLACK negative space, with crisp hard edges. IMPORTANT: flat ink, laser-sharp silhouette, strictly two solid colors on black. Preserve the original rounded letterforms.
